description: Returns all SuuntoPlus Guides (from push_workout_guide/push_interval_guide/push_strength_guide) on the user's account, newest first. Each item includes id, name, description, owner, localDate, and usage. Use the id with delete_guide, or with push_*_guide's guideId param to update an existing guide instead of creating a new one. Read-only.
name: list_guides
title: List SuuntoPlus guides
